faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Still have a question? Get in touch — we'll help.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. Free is free forever and includes one digital business card, a QR code, links, contact details, and automatic contact capture. No bank card is required. If you need more cards, custom design, or advanced analytics, you can move to Pro.

items.question: Why is this better than photographing a paper card?
items.answer: A photo stays a picture in your gallery: the details have to be retyped by hand, and they go stale along with the paper. A Naura card opens from a link, saves with one tap, and the introduction stays in your base with notes and tags.

items.question: What if I rarely meet new people?
items.answer: Your card link works everywhere you talk: in an email signature, in a chat, in your social bio. Even a rare introduction is saved in full, with its context and notes.

items.question: What if I change my mind?
items.answer: You can cancel Pro at any time, with no hidden terms. Your contacts remain yours, and you can export them back to your phone or address book in a couple of clicks.

items.question: Is it a website or an app?
items.answer: Both. Naura runs in a desktop browser and as an app on your phone: add it to your home screen and everything stays in sync instantly.

faq.contact: Can't find the answer? Email us at naura.io@naura.io.
